name: hutch-release
test: test -s index.html && test -s privacy.html && python3 -c "import xml.dom.minidom as m; m.parse('appcast.xml'); print('appcast ok')"
hostOnly: appcast.xml and DMG publishing are driven by Hutch release.sh with the Sparkle EdDSA key and GitHub auth
Live site (hutch.coursion.studio) checks need the production domain
notes: Static marketing site (GitHub Pages, CNAME, .nojekyll). No test suite exists, so test is a sanity check that key pages exist and appcast.xml is well-formed. For a visual check serve it with python3 -m http.server on a high port and use the preinstalled Playwright chromium.
